svg.title: Assignment Writer & Seeker Platform — System Architecture
svg.desc: Six-tier system architecture for a web-based assignment marketplace connecting seekers and writers, modelled on Rapido's layered architecture.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What features does the Assignment Seeker web app need?')

sendPrompt('How does real-time chat between seekers and writers work?')
sendPrompt('How do notifications work for assignment updates and bids?')

sendPrompt('What files does AWS S3 store for the assignment platform?')
